name: @zk-email/zk-regex-compiler
description: A compiler to generate a regex verification circuit in circom from a user-defined regex. Please check [zk-regex](https://github.com/zkemail/zk-regex/tree/main) for the detail.

scripts.build: cargo build && cargo install --path . --force && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ./pkg/ --scope zk-email
scripts.upload-binary-web-nightly: bun run build-web-release && wasm-pack publish-nightly -t web --out-dir ./pkg-web/
scripts.publish:alpha: bun run build && cd pkg && bun version preminor --preid=alpha && bun publish --tag alpha --access public
